description: Spec §7.6, §7.2: the player gets out of the car (the crosshair shows on foot) and the player's character fires (its Weapon's Fire from 4 m behind a target car, along +X). In the frame of the hit the race HUD's crosshair is red ((R=1.000000,G=0.150000,B=0.100000,A=1.000000)) at 1.3x; 0.55 s later (the 0.15 s marker plus one headless frame) it is white at 1x again. A shot straight down from the character into the road under it (a hit, but not on a car or a character) leaves it white at 1x.
